description: Land Acquisition - Thulhiriya, Warakapola D/S Division, Kegalle District and the amendment to the Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1891/37 of 05.12.2014 - Naula D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices about specific land parcels being acquired for public purposes, including descriptions of the land, lot numbers, extents, locations, and procedures for claiming compensation. The content focuses solely on land/property administrative matters without any government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other specialized categories.
